decisions.reason: The delayed follow-up notice applies to the optional tip transaction, not the Transak fiat purchase or wallet-provisioning flow.
The requested banner explains a separate post-mint tip transaction; it does not change when mint-success feedback appears or which mint token ID it displays.
The source adds explanatory feedback for the optional tip and does not alter the USDC approval or NFT mint flow.
The optional tip's delayed follow-up transaction does not change support for completing an NFT mint with ETH.
The source concerns tip-transaction messaging and does not change ETH pricing, swap, shortfall, or excess-refund rules.
The confirmation banner does not modify the $30 mint price or its creator, affiliate, and prize-pool allocation.
The source does not add, remove, or change any checkout payment option or currency-selection disclosure.
Explaining that a tip is not a second-copy purchase leaves the unlimited NFT ebook supply and asset format unchanged.
The client specifically requests an in-flow confirmation banner, not a change to the approved FAQ content.
The tip confirmation banner does not require any change to the About page's current content or prize descriptions.
The source only changes tip-transaction messaging and does not determine ticket allocation for purchases without a referral code.
The requested confirmation is a UI banner, not an email notification or change to transactional-email contents or delivery.
